answer: Simultaneous ceremony blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits for a ledge on the reef. Each epoch a ferrous-sealed summons calls all ledges at once; each echoes a code from its ledge in 10 minutes, key-signed. Auditors replay echoes; a missing or rented echo burns the bond. One body per ledge: 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 75,000. One honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its share; rented echoes burn the lender too.
